# Example entry with authoring metadata

**An example, not an entry.** `entries/example/fx-metadata/` here is the example entry with the
authoring metadata of RFC 0019 §3 (`description`, `compatibility`, `upgrade`), laid out as an entry
is, with its own `manifest.json` beside it. Every tree under `refused/` is this one with one change
that the format refuses. Nothing here is published by the Exchange, and the repository root's
`manifest.json` does not list it.
